request.style: English, cinematic orchestral hymn, pure female soprano with choir, strings, harp, oboe, French horn, soft timpani, reverent and luminous, 66 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Before the hills, before the sea, before the dawn of days
The Word was there with God, and he was God in all his ways
All things came into being through him, not one thing apart
In him was life, and that life was the light of every heart

[Chorus]
In the beginning was the Word
And the Word was with God, and the Word was God
The light shines in the darkness
And the darkness has not overcome it

[Verse]
There came a man sent from God, and John was his name
To testify about the light, a witness, so he came
The true light came into the world that through him came to be
The world did not know him, and his own would not receive

[Verse]
But to all who did receive him, who believed in his name
He gave the right to become children of God
Not born of blood or human will, but born of God above
Held in the Father's mercy and carried in his love

[Chorus]
In the beginning was the Word
And the Word was with God, and the Word was God
The light shines in the darkness
And the darkness has not overcome it

[Bridge]
And the Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us
And we have seen his glory
The glory of the Father's only Son
Full of grace and truth

[Outro]
The Word became flesh
Full of grace and truth
